description: This file is a PHP script for the Purchase Order edit view in a CRM system, responsible for rendering the Purchase Order edit interface, handling request parameters, fetching related data such as associated products, vendor info, taxes, and configuring display settings.

classes.name: CRMEntity
classes.description: Core CRM entity class providing methods for entity retrieval and management.

classes.name: vtigerCRM_Smarty
classes.description: Smarty template engine wrapper for CRM views.

methods.name: getAssociatedProducts
methods.description: Retrieves products associated with a specific module and record, optionally filtered by product ID.

methods.name: getInventoryCurrencyInfo
methods.description: Fetches currency information specific to the inventory item.

methods.name: setObjectValuesFromRequest
methods.description: Populates a CRM entity object with data from the HTTP request.

methods.name: getPricesForProducts
methods.description: Retrieves pricing information for given products under a specified currency.

methods.name: getProductName
methods.description: Returns the product name for a specified product ID.

methods.name: getPrdQtyInStck
methods.description: Returns the stock quantity for a given product ID.

methods.name: getProductTaxPercentage
methods.description: Returns the tax percentage for a product for a specific tax type.

methods.name: getAllTaxes
methods.description: Retrieves all applicable tax details, optionally filtered by type and mode.

methods.name: getParentTab
methods.description: Gets the parent tab category for the current module.

methods.name: getBlocks
methods.description: Fetches the UI blocks for a given module and view mode.

methods.name: getView
methods.description: Determines the current view mode (edit/create) for the focus object.

methods.name: updateInfo
methods.description: Provides update information for a record, such as audit details.

methods.name: getInventoryTotal
methods.description: Calculates the total inventory value for a module and record.

methods.name: getTabid
methods.description: Returns the tab ID for a specified module.

methods.name: split_validationdataArray
methods.description: Splits validation data into field names, datatypes, and labels.

methods.name: Button_Check
methods.description: Checks and returns the state of action buttons in the UI.

methods.name: getModuleSequenceField
methods.description: Retrieves the sequence number field for a module, if any.

methods.name: getTranslatedString
methods.description: Returns a translated string for a given label key.

methods.name: getAllCurrencies
methods.description: Returns a list of all supported currencies.

methods.name: vtlib_purify
methods.description: Sanitizes input data to prevent injections.

methods.name: vtlib_getFieldHelpInfo
methods.description: Provides help info for form fields based on module.
